name: merge-n1-check-ab
description: After the follow-ups (trace leaves life, founders mixed B sign) books check: 480 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, every N1 part on, C12g on; soap, linker, ion, mineral springs; N (60 s), 40 cells placed (80 s), a wash (100 s), resizes (150 s, 220 s), N1 switches off and on (120..200, 230..290), C12g switches and knobs off and on (300..380), G (390 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (420 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0; plus the trace shed off (205 s) and on (215 s) at runtime; snapshot round trip and a G with bSign plus then mixed

condition.name: merge-n1-check-ab
condition.description: After the follow-ups (trace leaves life, founders mixed B sign) books check: 480 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, every N1 part on, C12g on; soap, linker, ion, mineral springs; N (60 s), 40 cells placed (80 s), a wash (100 s), resizes (150 s, 220 s), N1 switches off and on (120..200, 230..290), C12g switches and knobs off and on (300..380), G (390 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (420 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0; plus the trace shed off (205 s) and on (215 s) at runtime; snapshot round trip and a G with bSign plus then mixed

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 1e9); if (!moire.oases.started) moire.oases.start(); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)
return moire.control.action('culture')
return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 40}, (_, k) => [150 + 13 * k, 120]), moire.genome.founders[0])
return moire.control.action('wash')

const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 400); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.4, 'ions', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'soap', 200); return 'springs again'
moire.pigments.params.matter = false; return 'pigments free'
moire.pigments.params.matter = true; moire.pigments.params.sat = false; return 'pigments built, no saturation'
moire.pigments.params.sat = true; moire.pigments.params.inhib = false; return 'saturation, no bleaching'
moire.pigments.params.inhib = true; moire.water.params.caustics = false; return 'caustics off'
moire.water.params.caustics = true; moire.water.params.currents = false; return 'currents off'
moire.pigments.params.shed = false; return 'shed off'
moire.pigments.params.shed = true; return 'shed on'
moire.water.params.currents = true; moire.water.params.speed = 2; moire.water.params.gyre = 2; return 'currents strong'
moire.water.params.speed = 0.35; moire.water.params.gyre = 0.25; moire.oases.params.scarce = false; return 'trace everywhere'
moire.oases.params.scarce = true; moire.oases.params.roam = false; moire.oases.params.count = 6; return 'oases fixed, 6'
moire.oases.params.roam = true; moire.oases.params.count = 2; moire.oases.params.life = 20; return 'oases roam, 2, short lives'
moire.oases.params.life = 300; moire.oases.params.count = 3; return 'oases back'
moire.ions.params.block = false; return 'block off'
moire.ions.params.block = true; moire.ions.params.genes = false; return 'block on, channel genes off'
moire.ions.params.genes = true; moire.ions.params.volt = true; moire.ions.params.kV = 20; return 'voltage push on, strong'
moire.ions.params.ionPass = 0; moire.ions.params.chanBase = 0.01; moire.pumps.params.vCap = 0.01; return 'ions nearly shut, small capacitance'
moire.ions.params.ionPass = 1; moire.ions.params.chanBase = 1; return 'ions wide open'

moire.ions.params.ionPass = 0.05; moire.ions.params.chanBase = 0.2; moire.ions.params.kV = 4; moire.ions.params.volt = false; moire.pumps.params.vCap = 0.1; moire.membrane.params.on = false; return 'knobs back, membrane chemistry off'
moire.membrane.params.on = true; moire.lipids.params.on = false; return 'lipids off'
moire.lipids.params.on = true; moire.charge.params.on = true; return 'lipids on, charge field on'
moire.charge.params.on = false; return 'charge field off'
return moire.control.action('genomes')
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }

moire.genome.params.bSign = 'plus'; moire.control.action('genomes'); const a = moire.genome.founders.map(g => Math.sign(g[62])); moire.genome.params.bSign = 'mixed'; moire.control.action('genomes'); return { plus: a, mixed: moire.genome.founders.map(g => Math.sign(g[62])) }
